message.name: NotificationToReceiveCancellationAdviceV10
message.definition: Scope|The NotificationToReceiveCancellationAdvice message is sent by an account owner or by a party acting on the account owner's behalf to one of the account owner's account servicing institutions. It is used to advise the account servicing institution about the cancellation of one or more notifications in a previous NotificationToReceive message.|Usage|The NotificationToReceiveCancellationAdvice message is used to advise the account servicing institution that the funds are no longer expected. The message can be used in either a direct or a relay scenario.

rules.name: IdentificationOrProxyPresenceRule
rules.text: Identification must be present or Proxy must be present. Both may be present.

rules.name: IdentificationAndProxyGuideline
rules.text: If the account identification is not defined through a conventional identification such as an email address or a mobile number, then the proxy element should be used for the identification of the account.

rules.name: RemittanceAmountAndTypeGuideline
rules.text: If Type/Code is equal to CREN, DUPA or REMI for RemittanceAmountAndType, RemittanceAmountAndType must not be repeated.

rules.name: DebtorRule
rules.text: Either Debtor or OriginalItem/Debtor may be present but not both.

rules.name: DebtorAgentRule
rules.text: Either DebtorAgent or OriginalItem/DebtorAgent may be present but not both.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgentRule
rules.text: Either IntermediaryAgent or OriginalItem/IntermediaryAgent may be present but not both.

rules.name: MandatoryDebtorRule
rules.text: Either Debtor must be present or OriginalItem/Debtor must be present.

rules.name: IntermediaryAgentAndDebtorAgentRule
rules.text: If IntermediaryAgent is present then DebtorAgent must be present.

rules.name: TotalAmountAndAmount1Rule
rules.text: If TotalAmount is present, then all occurrences of OriginalItem/Amount must have the same currency as the currency of TotalAmount.

rules.name: AccountAndCurrencyRule
rules.text: If Account is present, then all occurrences of OriginalItem/Amount must have the same currency.

rules.name: TotalAmountAndAmount2Rule
rules.text: If TotalAmount is present, then it must equal the sum of all occurrences of OriginalItem/Amount.

rules.name: AccountRule
rules.text: Either Account or OriginalItem/Account may be present but not both.

rules.name: AccountOwnerRule
rules.text: Either AccountOwner or OriginalItem/AccountOwner may be present but not both.

rules.name: AccountServicerRule
rules.text: Either AccountServicer or OriginalItem/AccountServicer may be present but not both.

rules.name: ExpectedValueDateRule
rules.text: Either ExpectedValueDate or OriginalItem/ExpectedValueDate may be present but not both.

rules.name: RelatedAccountRule
rules.text: Either RelatedAccount or OriginalItem/RelatedAccount may be present but not both.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.
